name: WRITER
description: Builds enterprise agents on WRITER's Palmyra models with chat completion, Knowledge Graph RAG, guardrails, and Agent Builder, via REST API, Python and Node SDKs, and a hosted MCP.

skills.name: Chat Completion
skills.description: Generates multi-turn responses from Palmyra models with tool calling, structured output, image input, and streaming.

skills.name: Knowledge Graph
skills.description: Indexes your content into graph-based RAG and answers questions against it with inline citations.

skills.name: Applications API
skills.description: Invokes deployed no-code agents as microservices, synchronously or asynchronously in batches.

skills.name: Agent Builder v2
skills.description: Deploys full-code agents to Writer from your IDE with GitHub sync, snapshots, and promotion to production.

skills.name: WRITER MCP Playbooks
skills.description: Runs published playbooks and reads Writer Meet recordings from any MCP client after signing in with a Writer account.
